candidate_list: CEC, 中選會審定115年直轄市長、直轄市議員、縣（市）長及縣（市）議員選舉候選人資格, 2026-10-16: https://web.cec.gov.tw/central/article/65213
note: blue = the side scored as 'blue share of the two contenders'. other = the main opponent. 'sure': false means the second contender is not settled; on the night, 'other' should be whichever non-blue candidate leads the count so far. 'baseline' lists the earlier races used for the swing; Kinmen and Matsu use only the mayoral race because the presidential KMT-vs-DPP split says little about KMT-vs-independent contests there.

races.why: KMT fielded no candidate (竹讓高虹安); 高's 2022 share tracked blue areas (village r = -0.7 to -0.8 vs the DPP presidential share).
Third candidate 邱建富 (ex-DPP, independent) polled 12.7% in August; the top two look settled.

three_way.why: 聯合報 2026-10-13..15, n=1,003: 陳素月 32%, 魏平政 16%, 邱建富 10%, undecided 42%. Two-way unless 邱 gets within 10 points of the leader in the count.

races.why: Independent backed by the KMT; the KMT fielded no candidate.
DPP fielded no candidate. 張峻 is now ahead of 魏嘉賢 in the latest poll (October); the two have swapped places during the year.

three_way.why: DPP fielded no candidate; two anti-傅 independents both poll in double digits. 關鍵調查 for Lai傳媒, 2026-10-24..27, n=1,202: 游淑貞 28.5%, 張峻 25.7%, 魏嘉賢 16.8%, 羅佩秦 0.5%, undecided 28.5% (67% of DPP supporters for 張). Earlier: 魏 led 張 28.6-21.8 (求真, April); 張 led 魏 19.4-18.4 (風傳媒, August). Model: 游 vs the non-KMT side by swing; 魏 (or whichever independent trails) as the third, projected from the count. Swap 張/魏 live if the count says so.

races.why: Six candidates; 周倪安 (台聯, former legislator) is the best known of the rest. No recent public poll found.

three_way.why: Six candidates; no recent public poll found. Watch whether a third candidate gets within 10 points in the count.

races.why: DPP fielded no candidate; six independents. 李文良 (former deputy magistrate under 陳福海, drew TPP supporters) is the most prominent, but no public poll ranks the challengers.

three_way.why: 陳玉珍 against several independents (李文良, 張國威, among others); no public poll ranks them. Possibly three-way if two independents split the anti-陳 vote evenly. "other" = whichever independent leads the count.

three_way_rule: On the night a race is shown as three-way when it is marked "expected" here, or, live, when a third candidate is in the top two or within 10 points of the leader in the count with at least 5% of stations in. Win chances in a three-way race start at the 5th station. The third candidate can be changed live (which independent is "other" and which is "third").
